name: edgegap-mcp
description: Deploy and run multiplayer game servers on Edgegap from Claude: dedicated servers, matchmaking, relays and the Edgegap agent skills.
long_description: The Edgegap MCP server, running on your own computer. Check a server Dockerfile, push the image, create the app version, deploy dedicated game servers near your players, read their logs and metrics, build a matchmaker config, and load the Edgegap agent skills (Unity, NGO, FishNet, PurrNet, Photon Fusion, Unreal, Godot, Colyseus, Nakama, PlayFab, Three.js, Manus). Guardrails: dry_run on every write tool, a cap on agent deployments, a max_duration ceiling, refusal of "latest" image tags and of the API token in containers, and the token scrubbed from every result. Your token stays on this computer and is sent only to api.edgegap.com.

api_token.title: Edgegap API token
api_token.description: From https://app.edgegap.com/user-settings?tab=tokens (the UUID only). It is organization-wide, so use a non-production organization for unattended agents.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that changes something on Edgegap.

app_allowlist.title: Application allowlist
app_allowlist.description: Comma-separated application names the agent may create versions in and deploy. Empty = all.

max_duration_minutes.title: Max duration ceiling (minutes)
max_duration_minutes.description: Highest max_duration the agent may set on a version.

max_agent_deployments.title: Max agent deployments
max_agent_deployments.description: Deploy is refused while this many agent-tagged deployments are running. 0 = no cap.
